name: Tonder
description: Tonder was the third planet in the Algaran system. It was a tectonically, seismically active world with incredible mining potential. It boasted one moon. The Algarian Bureau of Planetary Colonization and Bureau of Volcanoes disputed which bureau had jurisdiction over the planet.
